sections.Profile:
The "Cabaret" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in December 1968, is a four-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek, with artwork by Christian Marche.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Party, Good Times, Singing, Dancing, Nightlife, Music, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Steve Kordek
- Art: Christian Marche
